scopeCorrection.userClaim: 27 skills total across Basic / Bear / Tiger / Turtle
scopeCorrection.sourceFinding: Punch Club 1 Skills page says Basic has 24 unlockable nodes; Bear, Tiger and Turtle each have 27. The 2016 transcription yields 105 unlockable tree nodes total. Four core starting combat abilities (Punch/Kick/Block/Dodge) are added separately, so this file contains 109 skill/ability records.

formulas.damageFromStr: Damage = base value + modifier * STR; source examples show normal rounding (4.5→5, 3.1→3).
formulas.roundStructure: Fight can run up to 20 rounds. Within a round, a fight timer runs to zero while fighters alternate attack/defense phases; exact timer duration / fixed action count was not found.
formulas.offenseSlotOrder: Ability slot order has no meaning (developer reply). Moves are auto-selected; secondary sources describe random draws from selected skills. No deterministic slot cursor was found for Punch Club 1.
formulas.defenseSelection: Punch Club 1 sources describe one shared combat ability-slot set, not separate offense/defense slot arrays. Exact choice algorithm among multiple defenses was not found in official/wiki text. A community analysis reports automatic defense-failure probabilities (e.g. 1 defense skill ≈25% automatic failure), but this is not promoted to a verified engine formula. The game does not allow starting a fight with fewer equipped abilities than unlocked slots.
formulas.zeroEnergyPenalty: When energy is depleted, an opponent attack does 10 extra damage and knocks the fighter down. Exact knockdown duration and energy restored on ordinary get-up were not found. Diehard is a separate perk: chance to regain 30% energy after knockdown.
formulas.decisionRule: If neither fighter reaches 0 HP before 20 rounds, a game decision determines the winner; exact score/HP comparison formula was not found.
formulas.notes: Punch Club 1 has shared combat ability slots (max 5), not the Punch Club 2 split offense/defense-slot + initiative-cost model. Initiative-cost fields are null throughout. maxEnergy=100 is from a Steam community guide whose author labels parts of the guide guesswork; treat as community evidence. REG is the character combat-stat-page value; wiki explicitly says in-fight pop-up regeneration uses a smaller/unknown algorithm. ARM straight-deduction behavior is tentative on the wiki. Dodge formula explicitly unknown.
